text:
Maria: FYI customer on Enterprise hit our rerank endpoint and got a vague 413 'Request payload too large'. Ticket: #C-18291. They sent a very long user query + ~420 docs, asking why it failed and how to fix. :eyes:
Devin: Can you paste the request body (sanitized) and any server logs?
Maria: Pasting minimal repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-rerank-v1","query":"'"$(printf 'longquery %.0s' {1..200})'"","documents":["doc1...","doc2...", /* ~420 docs */]}'
```
Maria: In their case: query_chars ~= 18.6k, docs_total_chars ~= 1.25M, estimated_total_tokens ~= 85k.
infra-bot: staging-config: rerank.max_tokens=65536, max_documents=500.
Devin: Ok that matches a token-based cap. The 413 we return doesn't say whether the query, the docs, or count caused it. Customer assumed their query was the problem.
Nora: UX ask: can we make the error indicate which limit was hit and include a suggested remediation? e.g. return HTTP 413 + JSON {"code":"INPUT_SIZE_EXCEEDED","limit":"tokens","max":65536,"actual":85000,"hint":"try chunking documents into batches of <=100 or shorten query"} :+1:
Devin: Quick triage notes: reproduced in staging with same payload. Log entry: `ERROR rerank: input_size_exceeded query_tokens=2300 docs_tokens=82700 total=85000 limit=65536`. Server today just bubbles 413 with no structured details.
Maria: Customer asked for recommended client-side strategy — suggested: 1) chunk docs into multiple rerank calls (merge scores client-side), 2) trim long queries (remove verbose context), 3) prefilter docs with embeddings to reduce candidate set. Shared examples in KB.
Devin: I'll open a tiny backend task to add structured fields to the 413 body (code + limit_type + max + actual + docs_count). Low-risk change: log already emits numbers, so surface them in API error.
Nora: Also add a short note in docs/support KB that explains how to detect which side caused the overflow and sample curl for chunking. Can we include a link in the error JSON to the KB?
Devin: Yep, will include "help_url": "https://docs.redwood.ai/rerank/limits#input-size" in payload.
Maria: I'll reply to the customer with repro steps, temporary workarounds, and ETA for better error messaging.
Nora: Prioritize backlog: small API UX (high), docs (med). I'll create a ticket for product review.
infra-bot: deployment:staging rerank-service v1.28.4 running.
Maria: Thanks — closing internal triage, will post customer update in ticket. :thumbsup:
